title: Phonics and Bible Stories Quiz
description: Let's see what you learned about letters, sounds, and reading!

questions.question: Which of these is a vowel?
questions.explanation: A is a vowel! The five vowels are A, E, I, O, and U.

questions.question: What sound does the letter B make?
questions.explanation: B says 'buh' like in Bible and boy!

questions.question: When you put sounds together to make a word, it is called:
questions.explanation: Blending is when you put sounds together to make a word, like c-a-t makes cat!

questions.question: Which of these is a sight word?
questions.explanation: 'The' is one of the most common sight words! We see it in almost every sentence.

questions.question: What does the Bible sentence 'God is love' teach us?
questions.explanation: The Bible tells us 'God is love' in 1 John 4:8. God loves us very, very much!
